technique_name: Summarize the book Animal Farm in 100 words.
description: Animal Farm is a satirical fable about animal rebellion and a critique of totalitarianism. The novel tells the story of a group of animals living on a farm run by humans, who are eventually overthrown by the animals. The book follows the animals as they attempt to construct a society run by animals, and follows the rise and fall of their new leadership. The story is a cautionary tale about the consequences of unchecked power, personalized corruption, and other forms of tyrannical manipulation. I
